name: Example: Tag-Style Suffixes for SDXL
description: Short comma-separated suffixes for tag-based SDXL checkpoints. For Krea 2 use the sentence-style libraries instead.

presets.title: Tags | Early phone snapshot
presets.prompt: photo, amateur snapshot, early mobile phone camera, low resolution, jpeg artifacts, digital noise, soft focus, slight motion blur, direct flash, color cast, candid, casual framing

presets.title: Tags | 35mm film
presets.prompt: analog photo, 35mm film, film grain, soft contrast, warm tones, faded colors, light leak, natural light, candid

presets.title: Tags | Studio portrait
presets.prompt: photo, studio portrait, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, bokeh, softbox lighting, rim light, sharp focus, detailed skin texture, plain backdrop

presets.title: Tags | Black and white film
presets.prompt: monochrome, greyscale, black and white photo, film grain, high contrast, deep shadows, documentary photography

presets.title: Tags | VHS still
presets.prompt: vhs still, analog video, scan lines, interlacing, chromatic aberration, color bleeding, tracking noise, low resolution, washed out colors

presets.title: Tags | Cinematic still
presets.prompt: film still, cinematic, anamorphic lens, lens flare, teal and orange, shallow depth of field, film grain, dramatic lighting
